label: Reused truth, knowledge, performed-denial and Eleatic boundaries
summary: Analyst comparison, attribution deferred. True and False witness the two separate polar failures inside Lean Prop. On a supplied content domain the collapse controls allow all-hold and all-fail; application to a wider truth domain needs expressed negation or reflection, and the no-absolute-truth thesis test specifically needs scope and disquotation, plus capture to eliminate the global predicate denial itself. Knowledge of universal ignorance is ruled out by factivity, while an assertion of that same true denial is compatible with no knowledge. Performed denial excludes an accurate denial only when the act is among the episodes denied; the empty control retains the unperformed truth and the static control retains occurrence without state variation. Cogito by performed doubt needs an occurrence witness plus the doubting-to-thinking bridge. Eleatic retorsion needs actual opining and opinion-as-motion, and the exact general-change alternative opposes F3 on the same change predicate. These are different grounds for a conditional inconsistency.
blocker: A restricted truth predicate, nonassertive scepticism, and static occurrence without a same-sense change witness survive their respective formal tests. Reopen when a specific language warrants the needed truth reflection, a putative knower or assertion-to-knowledge bridge is independently warranted, or a motion or general-change bridge connects the denial act to the same predicate the thesis denies.
